scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid entering a forecasted storm delay with the home propane tank near the refill threshold and no standard-route stop arranged.
Emerging Need: A vague storm outlook is only background; tank level, service-lane work, upgraded rain risk, and a same-day route cutoff later align.
Decision Context: Observable updates establish weather, route timing, and access constraints, while the stored propane profile holds the account, dispatch route, tank approach, and no-emergency-fee preference.
Consequence: Timely attention can preserve a routine refill option before routes lock; after the west Enid route closes, the ordinary pre-storm addition is unavailable; the evidence does not establish imminent fuel exhaustion. A31% tank is near, not below, the30% routine review threshold; prepare a standard-route inquiry without placing a paid refill order.

parameter.subject: Early outlook: stronger storms possible Tuesday night
parameter.body: The Sunday outlook notes a developing dryline setup for north-central Oklahoma late Tuesday into Wednesday. Confidence is still moderate to low, but heavy rain and damaging wind are possible if the system organizes. Updated watches are expected Monday.

parameter.title: Park office: west service-lane gravel grading
parameter.description: Cedar Meadow Home Park notice placed on the calendar: grading crew will work the west gravel service lane; avoid unscheduled service-truck traffic through the work area after the equipment is staged.

parameter.subject: Daily tank estimate: 31 percent
parameter.body: Red Prairie Propane's remote estimate for the lot 18 customer tank is 31 percent as of Monday morning. The account is not on automatic refill. Standard-route customers are normally reviewed for refill tickets once estimates fall below 30 percent.

parameter.subject: Storm update: heavy rain and wind likely Tuesday night
parameter.body: Forecast confidence has increased for severe storms Tuesday night into early Wednesday around Enid. The update highlights quick rainfall on unpaved lanes, wind gusts above 60 mph, and likely delays for rural service traffic after storms begin.

parameter.content: Operations note for west Enid manufactured-home park customers: Tuesday morning's standard route is the last planned pre-storm route. New standard-route additions for that area close today at 14:30. Storm detours may pause later standard additions until Friday.

parameter.subject: West Enid standard-route additions closed
parameter.body: Red Prairie dispatch has closed Tuesday's west Enid standard-route manifest as of 14:30. The next open standard addition window for that area is Friday, subject to storm recovery and road access.
